episodes.title: Into the Lion's Den
episodes.summary: Noni is offered a chance to return to the Dora Milaje if she can capture a powerful warrior known as The Lion, who has been using Wakandan resources for his own personal gain. Noni must infiltrate the heavily guarded City of Ships to confront the Lion and complete her mission.

episodes.title: Legends and Lies
episodes.summary: Under cover as a Greek soldier, Memnon works alongside heroes of legend to infiltrate Troy, while carrying out a secret mission to recover a Wakandan artifact deep within the city walls. The Greeks devise a plan to catch the Trojans off guard and sneak inside the city. As the attack intensifies, Memnon must decide how far he is willing to go to protect Wakanda's secret.

episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.summary: After a successful mission in the mountains of China, Basha returns home, unaware that a stowaway is aboard his transport. Back in the Golden City, Basha scrambles to contain the powerful intruder before anyone finds out. An old rival of his discovers the breach and seeks to thwart any attempt for Basha to save face and handle the situation quietly.

episodes.title: The Last Panther
episodes.summary: During the first Italo-Ethiopian War, Kuda and Prince Tafari are tasked with retrieving a vibranium ax. On their return home, an intruder intercepts their transport to try and return the ax back where they found it, revealing that the fate of their world is at stake if not returned. Prince Tafari and Kuda must choose to complete their mission or trust the stranger's words and defy their homeland.
